import ImbalancedChen.ActualSmallRosser
import ImbalancedChen.FixedRoughCoefficients
import ImbalancedChen.RealHalfProductSource

/-!
# Finite identities for the actual upper coefficient on a common carrier

The original actual coefficient and real-source signed functionals are defined
here together with their exact finite carrier identities. Their names, types
and bodies are unchanged. The analytic target-density bound remains in
ActualUpperCommonCarrier with its original reserve and asymptotic dependencies.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

/-- The displayed physical modulus support for the actual small/rough pair. -/
def actualSmallRoughModuli (retainOdd : List ℕ → Bool)
    (N cap : ℕ) (w z : ℝ) : Finset ℕ :=
  smallRoughModuli (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
    (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z)

/-- One physical coefficient, independent of the integer at which it is tested. -/
def actualSmallRoughRho (retainOdd : List ℕ → Bool)
    (N cap : ℕ) (w z L : ℝ) : ℕ → ℝ :=
  smallRoughRho (actualSmallRosserSupport N cap w)
    (fixedRoughSupport retainOdd N cap w z)
    (fixedRoughCoefficient retainOdd N cap w z)
    (actualSmallRosserMinus N cap w L) (actualSmallRosserPlus N cap w L)

open scoped BigOperators

/-- The actual congruence mass of the arbitrary-real ordered source. -/
def realHalfProductCongruenceMass (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (((realHalfProductSource b N T).filter
    (fun m : ℕ => Nat.ModEq d m N)).card : ℝ)

/-- The same source restricted by the literal coprimality mask. -/
def realHalfProductCoprimeMass (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (d : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (((realHalfProductSource b N T).filter
    (fun m : ℕ => Nat.Coprime m d)).card : ℝ)

/-- The exact price of replacing the coprime mass by the total real source. -/
def realPhysicalCoprimeCorrection
    (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
    ((realHalfProductCoprimeMass b N T d -
      ((realHalfProductSource b N T).card : ℝ)) / (Nat.totient d : ℝ))

/-- The signed primitive-residue error for exactly the displayed coefficient. -/
def realPhysicalDistributionError
    (b : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (Q : Finset ℕ) (rho : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ d ∈ Q, rho d *
    (realHalfProductCongruenceMass b N T d -
      realHalfProductCoprimeMass b N T d / (Nat.totient d : ℝ))

/-- Enlarging the displayed rough support enlarges its product carrier. -/
theorem smallRoughModuli_subset_of_rough_subset
    (small : Finset ℕ) {raw rough : Finset ℕ} (hsub : raw ⊆ rough) :
    smallRoughModuli small raw ⊆ smallRoughModuli small rough := by
  intro q hq
  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hq with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x,
    Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨(Finset.mem_product.mp hx).1, hsub (Finset.mem_product.mp hx).2⟩, rfl⟩

/-- Zero extension preserves the whole physical function, not only its
density. Cutoff separation is not needed for this finite fibre identity. -/
theorem smallRoughRho_eq_of_rough_enlargement
    (small : Finset ℕ) {raw rough : Finset ℕ} (hsub : raw ⊆ rough)
    (c betaMinus betaPlus : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ d ∈ rough, d ∉ raw → c d = 0) :
    smallRoughRho small rough c betaMinus betaPlus =
      smallRoughRho small raw c betaMinus betaPlus := by
  classical
  funext q
  unfold smallRoughRho
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hx with ⟨hx, hprod⟩
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨(Finset.mem_product.mp hx).1, hsub (Finset.mem_product.mp hx).2⟩, hprod⟩
  · intro x hx hnot
    rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hx with ⟨hx, hprod⟩
    have hraw : x.2 ∉ raw := by
      intro hd
      exact hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨(Finset.mem_product.mp hx).1, hd⟩, hprod⟩)
    simp only [smallRoughPairCoefficient, signAttachedCoefficient,
      hzero x.2 (Finset.mem_product.mp hx).2 hraw, zero_mul]

/-- Every signed linear functional has exactly the same raw value after
carrier enlargement. In particular, no absolute discrepancy is introduced. -/
theorem sum_smallRoughRho_mul_eq_of_rough_enlargement
    (small : Finset ℕ) {raw rough : Finset ℕ} (hsub : raw ⊆ rough)
    (c betaMinus betaPlus : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ d ∈ rough, d ∉ raw → c d = 0) (F : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (∑ q ∈ smallRoughModuli small rough,
      smallRoughRho small rough c betaMinus betaPlus q * F q) =
        ∑ q ∈ smallRoughModuli small raw,

/-- All displayed small/rough pairs. -/
def smallRoughPairs (small rough : Finset ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) :=
  small ×ˢ rough

/-- Their multiplicity-free physical modulus support. -/
def smallRoughModuli (small rough : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (smallRoughPairs small rough).image fun x => x.1 * x.2

/-- On cutoff-separated supports, multiplication is injective on the entire
displayed pair support. -/
theorem smallRough_mul_injOn
    {w : ℝ} {small rough : Finset ℕ}
    (hsmall : ∀ d ∈ small, SmallPrimeSupportedAt w d)
    (hrough : ∀ d ∈ rough, RoughPrimeSupportedAt w d) :
    Set.InjOn (fun x : ℕ × ℕ => x.1 * x.2) (smallRoughPairs small rough) := by
  intro d hd e he hprod
  change d ∈ small ×ˢ rough at hd
  change e ∈ small ×ˢ rough at he
  rw [Finset.mem_product] at hd he
  exact smallRough_factorization_unique
    (hsmall d.1 hd.1) (hrough d.2 hd.2)
    (hsmall e.1 he.1) (hrough e.2 he.2) hprod

/-- The sign-sensitive coefficient attached to one small/rough pair. -/
def smallRoughPairCoefficient
    (roughCoeff betaMinus betaPlus : ℕ → ℝ) (x : ℕ × ℕ) : ℝ :=
  signAttachedCoefficient (roughCoeff x.2)
    (betaMinus x.1) (betaPlus x.1)

/-- One physical coefficient function.  It is defined as the finite fibre
sum so it is total off the displayed support; uniqueness below proves that
every occupied fibre has exactly one term. -/
def smallRoughRho
    (small rough : Finset ℕ)
    (roughCoeff betaMinus betaPlus : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x ∈ smallRoughPairs small rough with x.1 * x.2 = q,
    smallRoughPairCoefficient roughCoeff betaMinus betaPlus x

/-- At an occupied product, the physical coefficient is exactly the one
pair coefficient, with no multiplicity factor. -/
theorem smallRoughRho_mul
    {w : ℝ} {small rough : Finset ℕ}
    (hsmall : ∀ d ∈ small, SmallPrimeSupportedAt w d)
    (hrough : ∀ d ∈ rough, RoughPrimeSupportedAt w d)
    (roughCoeff betaMinus betaPlus : ℕ → ℝ)
    {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ small) (hb : b ∈ rough) :
    smallRoughRho small rough roughCoeff betaMinus betaPlus (a * b) =
      smallRoughPairCoefficient roughCoeff betaMinus betaPlus (a, b) := by
  classical
  have hab : (a, b) ∈ smallRoughPairs small rough := by
    simp [smallRoughPairs, ha, hb]
  unfold smallRoughRho
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (a, b)]
  · intro x hx hne
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
    exact (hne ((smallRough_mul_injOn hsmall hrough) hx.1 hab hx.2)).elim
  · intro hnot
    exact (hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hab, rfl⟩)).elim

/-- The physical coefficient vanishes away from the product support. -/
theorem smallRoughRho_eq_zero_of_not_mem
    (small rough : Finset ℕ)
    (roughCoeff betaMinus betaPlus : ℕ → ℝ)
    {q : ℕ} (hq : q ∉ smallRoughModuli small rough) :
    smallRoughRho small rough roughCoeff betaMinus betaPlus q = 0 := by

  intro x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hx
  exfalso
  exact hq (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx.1, hx.2⟩)
